Springback Sanctum.name: Springback Sanctum
Springback Sanctum.description: The user wraps a whole scene, up to a city block, in layered elastic panes they reshape on the fly. For the rest of the scene, every punch, charge, thrown object and bullet an enemy aims at the user's allies or at bystanders sinks into a pane and flies straight back at the attacker, who takes force damage; fire, light, gas and electricity still pass. The user cannot move while holding it. Strain: severe.
